The '''2015–16 [[Super League Greece]]''' was the 80th season of the highest tier in league of [[Football in Greece|Greek]] [[Association football|football]] and the tenth under its current title. The season started on 22 August 2015 and ended in May 2016. The league comprised fourteen teams from the 2014–15 season and two promoted from the [[2014–15 Football League (Greece)|2014–15 Football League]]. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their sixth consecutive title and 43rd overall, making a record collection of points (85 out of 90) in a championship of 30 games.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.gazzetta.gr/stili/afierwmata/article/906542/ola-ta-rekor-toy-fetinoy-olympiakoy | title=Όλα τα ρεκόρ του φετινού Ολυμπιακού! &#124; Gazzetta }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.fosonline.gr/podosfairo/superleague/article/47660/to-rekor-toy-olympiakoy-poy-den-tha-katarripsei-oyte-fetos-o-paok |title=Αρχειοθετημένο αντίγραφο |accessdate=2019-10-15 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191015125144/https://www.fosonline.gr/podosfairo/superleague/article/47660/to-rekor-toy-olympiakoy-poy-den-tha-katarripsei-oyte-fetos-o-paok |archivedate=2019-10-15 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Teams==
Four teams were relegated from the [[2014–15 Super League Greece|2014–15 season]]. [[PAE Kerkyra|Kerkyra]] and [[Ergotelis F.C.|Ergotelis]] play in [[Football League (Greece)|Football League]] for the 2015–16 season. [[Niki Volos F.C.|Niki Volos]] and [[OFI Crete F.C.|OFI]] would play in [[Gamma Ethniki]].

Two teams were promoted from the [[2014–15 Football League (Greece)|2014–15 Football League]], champions [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] and [[Iraklis F.C. (Thessaloniki)|Iraklis]], two teams with a long history in the top championship of Greece.

==Play-offs==
In the play-off for Champions League, the four qualified teams play each other in a home-and-away [[Round-robin tournament|round robin]]. However, they do not all start with 0 points: instead, a weighting system applies to the teams' standing at the start of the play-off mini-league. The team finishing in fifth in the Super League will start the play-off with 0 points. Its end-of-season tally of points is then used to calculate the number of points with which the other teams will start the play-offs: more specifically, each of the three other teams participating in the play-offs will have the fifth-placed team's total points tally subtracted from their own points tally and then divided by five – giving the final figure.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://jamesg.co.uk/2011/01/13/aek-aris-paok-olympiakos-and-the-greek-playoffs-do-they-work/ |title = AEK, Aris, PAOK, Olympiakos and the Greek Playoffs: Do they work? {{!}} jamesG  |access-date=25 May 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160604080843/https://jamesg.co.uk/2011/01/13/aek-aris-paok-olympiakos-and-the-greek-playoffs-do-they-work/ |archive-date=4 June 2016 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
